creative_direction: Paint an original 35-year-old man with short silver-gray curls and a broad, thoughtful face. Keep the expression open and ordinary, avoiding heroic poses, heavy aging lines, or celebrity resemblance. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
